title: Memory leak and unreadable text in Run
author: CircuitDaemon
summary: PowerToys Run can reproduce the known long-query text overlap, while the same session reportedly accumulates substantial memory after repeated occurrences. The attached diagnostics and screenshots establish the symptoms, but the report does not yet distinguish retained query results from process memory that remains after Run is dismissed.

status.label: Memory-growth sequence needed
status.detail: The text overlap is already tracked by issue 13554; a short repeatable sequence and memory-release observation are needed to triage the additional memory-growth symptom.

next_action.label: Request focused memory observations
next_action.reason: Separate the known visual duplicate from a potentially distinct retained-memory defect.

judgment.rationale: The supplied string deterministically reproduces the visual overlap and a diagnostic archive is attached, but the memory symptom is described only as occurring after several attempts and does not say whether memory is released after clearing the query or dismissing Run.
evidence: The reporter supplied a deterministic mixed-character long-query string, before/after screenshots of overlapping text, and clarified that a single repeated character does not trigger the same visual failure.
Issue 13554 is the open canonical tracker for long PowerToys Run input and suggestion text becoming misaligned.
The reporter supplied a PowerToys diagnostic archive and a screenshot showing high PowerToys Run memory usage.
The issue does not record the number of repetitions, whether the query results were allowed to finish, or whether memory returns after clearing or closing Run.
The issue body was updated to clarify the mixed-character trigger, but it still does not record a memory timeline or confirmation on the current release.
judgment.recommended_action: Acknowledge the existing overlap tracker and request a minimal repeat sequence on the current PowerToys release, including memory before reproduction, after each repetition, and after clearing and dismissing Run.

issue_context.summary: A long Run query causes overlapping text and is followed, after repeated attempts, by slowdown and high memory use.
known_information: The issue reproduces on PowerToys 0.97.2 on Windows 11 build 26200 with PowerToys elevated.
The reporter supplied an exact mixed-character long string that triggers the visual problem after one additional character and clarified that one repeated character type alone does not trigger it.
Before/after screenshots show the visual overlap, and another screenshot shows substantial PowerToys Run memory usage.
A PowerToys diagnostic ZIP and text attachment are already present.
Issue 13554 is the open tracker for the long-input preview-text alignment defect.
inferences: The visual symptom is likely another instance of issue 13554.
The memory growth may be a separate defect, but the current report does not establish whether the process retains memory after query results and the Run window are released.
issue_context.analysis: The existing evidence is sufficient to route the overlap to issue 13554, but closing the whole report as a duplicate could discard the potentially distinct memory symptom. A short memory timeline around a deterministic repetition would show whether there is persistent retention worth investigating separately.
initial_investigation: Compared the visual symptom with issues 13554, 36171, and 37698; issue 36171 was explicitly closed as a duplicate of 13554.
Inspected the current LauncherControl layout, where the editable query TextBox and separate autocomplete TextBlock render in the same grid and can scroll independently.
Confirmed that the report already includes a diagnostic archive, so another generic bug-report request is unnecessary.

information_gaps.information: A minimal repetition count and memory timeline on the current PowerToys release.
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes transient memory used by active query results from memory retained after the Run interaction has ended.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: After updating PowerToys, record PowerToys Run memory before testing, after each repetition of the supplied query, after clearing the query, and after dismissing Run for about one minute.

information_gaps.information: Whether the memory growth occurs when autocomplete is disabled or when the query produces no suggestion.
information_gaps.why_needed: The visual duplicate involves the separate suggestion text; this comparison indicates whether the memory symptom follows suggestion/result generation or the query TextBox itself.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Repeat the same long-input test once with autocomplete disabled, or with a similarly long query that produces no suggestion, and report whether memory still grows.

comment.body: Thanks for the exact query, screenshots, and diagnostic ZIP. The overlapping long-input text is already tracked in #13554, but the sustained memory growth may be a separate problem. After updating to the current PowerToys release, please record PowerToys Run memory before testing, after each repetition of the supplied query, after clearing the query, and about one minute after dismissing Run. Please also repeat once with autocomplete disabled, or with a similarly long query that produces no suggestion, and tell us whether memory still grows. That will show whether memory is retained after the interaction and whether it follows suggestion/result generation or the query box itself.
